title: 第14章
content:
“还要，还要，还要，要求那么多，你是当自己在菜市场买菜啊！”王金虎忍无可忍，上手拍了一把他的脑袋。“那相亲不就是挑菜吗，我总归是要挑合我口味的。”王多多缩着脖子嘟囔。老王气不打一处来，“你再说一遍”！王多多气得扯着脖子抗议，“可我也不能随便找个alpha，凑合着过日子吧，我提点要求怎么了？”老王还好意思说他要求多，也不好好反省自己，要不是他年轻的时候不努力，只生了他这么一个omega；他也不至于身兼重任，被逼着相亲。王多多眼珠子一动，凑到他爸跟前。“爸，要不这样，我看你身体康健，气质也不错，还招人喜欢，你再给我找个小妈，生个alpha弟弟，我保证这速度绝对比我找老公来得快多了。”反正他爹是乐安市商界出了名的黄金单身alpha。虽然带着他这么一个拖油瓶。但是就他这‘风韵犹存’的长相，若是在圈子里喊一喊，一定会有一堆漂亮年轻漂亮的omega黏上来。想当他后妈的人虽然不能排到法国，但是起码勉强能排成一条长街。就相貌和身材这方面来说，王多多对他家老王有信心。当然，也是这一点。王多多经常怀疑自己是不是他亲生的。因为他长得不像老王。前两年的某一天，老王去谈合作，非要拎上王多多去；说要带他耳濡目染学习一下做生意。结果碰上个眼生的合作对象。对方走前，还乐呵得赞美一句：王总，你这助理胖得挺喜庆啊。王多多：“.…..”他这是奶膘，是婴儿肥！这下子，王多多彻底炸毛了，他不干了。什么鬼！王多多气的一个月不肯出门。发誓要减肥。当然。最后他和所有想减肥的人一样的结局。肥没减成，还重了5斤。也不知道肉长哪里去了。

就这事，他被李沐然笑话了好久。爱谁谁！他爸不就是想找个人接班嘛。只要他爹再生个alpha弟弟出来，那所有得问题都迎刃而解了。王金虎愣了下，脸立马沉了下来。他深吸一口气，右手往腰间一掏，甩出一条长长的烫金鞭。“啪！”鞭子狠狠抽打在地砖上。“啊啊啊啊！”王多多吓得脖子都缩了起来，像个小猴子似得立马蹦到沙发上。他拿起抱枕挡在自己前头，哆嗦道，“爸，你淡…淡定…别生气嘛。”“成天油嘴滑舌的，没个正形，你再给我胡说八道试试看，也不知道你这嘴皮子到底随了谁？”“哼！”王多多气呼呼得探出脑袋，“反正，不是像你，那就是像我那个没有缘分的妈，你俩就是罪魁祸首！”从小，他一直想知道妈妈到底在哪里，究竟是死是活，可是老王嘴巴很紧，一直很不肯说。每次被老王凶，他就特别委屈，别人家都有妈妈疼，就他没有。王金虎眼眸一黯，左手死捏着沙发，沙发的扶手捏得变形还不自知。他抿着唇，把相册重新抛到王多多面前。“哪这么多废话，我还能给你找些歪瓜裂枣的不成。”“那可不一定。”王多多忍不住嘟囔。王金虎右手攥紧鞭子，然后把鞭子扬得高高。“看不看！你今天是不是非要等我把你的屁股揍开花才乐意是吗？”这架势摆的，颇有王多多敢反驳一句，那鞭子就要甩下来。“看看看看，我看，我看，你别急啊”王多多见着老王难看的脸色，手忙脚乱的捧起相册，缩着腿往沙发里头躲。这怎么搞的跟逼良为娼似得。哼。他掀开封面，懒散的低眸，突然顿住了身子，大叫了一声，“啊！”他再翻一面，“啊！”翻了一面又一面，“哦~”好家伙。老王冷眼瞟过来，“干嘛又一惊一乍得”
content_en:
"More, more, more, you're asking for so much, you think you're buying food at the market!" Wang Jinhu couldn't bear it anymore and slapped him on the head."Then blind dates are just about choosing dishes. I always have to choose the ones that suit my taste." Wang Duoduo muttered, shrinking his neck.Lao Wang was so angry that he said, "Say it again!"Wang Duoduo was so angry that he scratched his neck and protested, "But I can't just find an alpha and live a makeshift life. What's wrong with me making some demands?" Lao Wang still had the nerve to say that he had too many demands and didn't reflect on himself. If he hadn't worked hard when he was young and only gave birth to an omega like him, he wouldn't have had to hold important responsibilities and be forced to go on a blind date.Wang Duoduo's eyes moved and he came closer to his father."Dad, if not, I think you are in good health, have a good temperament, and are popular. If you find me a baby mother and give birth to an alpha brother, I guarantee that it will be much faster than me finding a husband." Anyway, his father is a famous golden single alpha in the business community of Le'an City.Even though he is such a dragster.But with his "charming" appearance, if he shouts in the circle, there will definitely be a bunch of beautiful, young and beautiful omegas attached to him.Although the people who wanted to be his stepmother couldn't line up as far as France, they could at least line up a long street.In terms of appearance and figure, Wang Duoduo has confidence in his Lao Wang.Of course, this is also the case.Wang Duoduo often doubts whether she is his biological child.Because he doesn't look like Lao Wang.One day two years ago, Lao Wang went to discuss cooperation and insisted on taking Wang Duoduo with him; he said that he would take him to learn how to do business.As a result, I met an unfamiliar partner.Before the other party left, he happily praised: Mr. Wang, your assistant is so fat and happy.Wang Duoduo: "..." This is milk fat, baby fat!At this time, Wang Duoduo was completely furious and quit.What the hell!Wang Duoduo was so angry that he refused to go out for a month.Vow to lose weight.certainly.In the end, he ended up like everyone else who wants to lose weight.I haven't lost any weight yet and still gained 5 pounds.I don’t know where the meat went.

For this matter, he was laughed at by Li Muran for a long time.Love so and so!His dad just wants to find someone to take over.As long as his father has another alpha brother, all problems will be solved.Wang Jinhu was stunned for a moment, and his face immediately sank.He took a deep breath, reached for his waist with his right hand, and whipped out a long gold whip."Crack!" The whip struck the floor tiles hard."Ahhhh!" Wang Duoduo was so frightened that his neck shrank and he immediately jumped onto the sofa like a little monkey.He picked up the pillow and put it in front of him, trembling and saying, "Dad, be calm...calm...don't be angry." "You've always been slick and talkative, and you don't have any integrity. If you try to talk nonsense to me again, I don't know who you are following this talk?" "Humph!" Wang Duoduo was angry.He stuck his head out and said, "Anyway, it's either like you, or it's like my unfated mother. You two are the culprits!" Since childhood, he has always wanted to know where his mother is and whether she is dead or alive, but Lao Wang is very tight-lipped and has always been reluctant to tell.Every time he was treated badly by Lao Wang, he felt particularly aggrieved. Other families had mothers who cared for him, but he did not.Wang Jinhu's eyes darkened, and he held the sofa tightly with his left hand. The armrest of the sofa was deformed without even realizing it.He pursed his lips and threw the photo album in front of Wang Duoduo again."With all this nonsense, I can still find you some crooked melons and cracked jujubes." "That's not necessarily true." Wang Duoduo couldn't help but mutter.Wang Jinhu held the whip tightly in his right hand and raised the whip high."Don't you look at it! Do you have to wait for me to beat your ass today before you are happy?" This posture was such that Wang Duoduo dared to retort, and the whip was about to be thrown off."Look, look, let's see, let's see, don't worry." Seeing Lao Wang's ugly face, Wang Duoduo hurriedly picked up the photo album, shrunk his legs and hid in the sofa.How can this be done like forcing a good girl into prostitution?snort.He opened the cover, looked down lazily, suddenly stopped, and shouted, "Ah!" He turned it over again, "Ah!" and turned it over again and again, "Oh~" Good guy.Lao Wang glanced over coldly, "Why are you so surprised again?"
